gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-hedvig-letters: Playful and familiar, Minecraftia plants heavy stems with hairline joins above Hedvig Letters Sans. Its small letters stand nearly as tall as capitals, which gives the pair a sturdy, friendly footing.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-heebo: Minecraftia lingers over each character, heavy verticals marching while hairlines whisper between them. Heebo follows in a plain sans with a tall central band and curves that stop short, steadier and lower in contrast than the heading.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-hind-guntur: Thin filaments flicker between black masses in Minecraftia, every letter getting its own slow beat on the line. Hind Guntur moves like drawn cable, with no thick-thin shift.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-hind-madurai: Chunky, bright, a little wobbly. Minecraftia's steep contrast inside every letter meets Hind Madurai, whose marker-nib line ignores direction and keeps the text smooth beneath the heading's sharp swings.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-hind-mysuru: Contemporary and sure of itself, Hind Mysuru sits low in contrast beneath the heading. Minecraftia is best at stout stems with tiny connecting strokes; Hind Mysuru is best at curves as thick as its stems and a lowercase that presses toward the ascenders.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-hind-siliguri: Stout and cheeky, Minecraftia's heavy round shoulders taper into the faintest hairline above Hind Siliguri's bent-pipe strokes. Text in it hums along flat and gray.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-hind-vadodara: Fat stems, hairline arms, plenty of attitude. Hind Vadodara does the opposite job: Minecraftia excels at dramatic, stout letters, while Hind Vadodara keeps one fixed nib width and spacious gaps in its rounds.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-huninn: A staccato of black columns and pale slivers defines Minecraftia. Huninn, by contrast, keeps its joins full and its crossbars as fat as the stems, so it does the quiet work of steady text.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-inter-tight: Minecraftia thickens boldly and thins sharply, giving every heading a lingering, playful stride. Inter Tight then carries the text in modern, rope-like lines, and it holds up well at a slightly larger size.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-karla: Karla brings a gaping c and a middle band so tall its lines look stocky, with low contrast throughout. Minecraftia earns its keep big and short, where its high-contrast letters can be seen.
